To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the design of a product for a specific population is not enough, but it is necessary to take into account the context in which they live, their way of life, their customs and the culture in which they develop.

the design process is a complex process, which involves a series of activities that require the contribution of several disciplines and that the design process must be based on the user's needs and not on the designer's ideas.

the furniture designed is portable, sustainable, and has the potential to be a learning and playful tool, and it is also a mediating object for the development of basic cognitive processes for children of the age range of six to seven years old, and that it can also be used in educational institutions that do not have sufficient resources to have furniture.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a product that allows the appropriation of the object, which is not only a piece of furniture, but also an educational tool.
the design and development of an object that is not only a piece of furniture, but that is a tool for the development of children's cognitive processes.

the creation of a product that allows the development of cognitive skills in children, in addition to the appropriation of the space, and the development of the creative capacity of the children themselves.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the project was carried out successfully, as the product was designed according to the specifications of the user and the needs of the educational institutions.
it is an educational and playful product that contributes to the development of children in the early stages of education.

this work is the result of an interdisciplinary and interinstitutional work, which allows to generate an innovative product, with the participation of children in the process of design and construction of a product that will benefit their education.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the design of a product that is not just a product but an experience that allows children to have a more complete development.
the product has been developed as an educational object that allows the appropriation of the object in a playful way and that allows the development of cognitive and logical processes in the user.

it is possible to develop products with a high degree of complexity, with the contribution of the various disciplines, and that the design of the product is not limited to the development of the object itself, but to the appropriation of the same, in this case the furniture is an element of learning, and the design is the process of creating a product that allows the user to appropriate it.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the furniture is an object that allows the development of the child’s learning, in addition to being a tool to promote sustainable practices in the school community.

the product has been well received by the educational community, which is reflected in the fact that the furniture was used in the educational process and was well received by the children, who have shown a great interest in the furniture and the educational process that it allows.
the design of the furniture is not a mere aesthetic exercise, it is a process of social inclusion and development of the child.
